scenario.title: Test 14: Adversarial - 5 Slots Volunteered in a Single Utterance
dialogue: It's my sole-owned residential property, original documents are available, I need 40 lakhs, and prefer 10 years.
I work as a salaried executive with salary credited to bank account.
Current market value is about 95 lakhs.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Neha Kapoor, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Neha Kapoor?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It's my sole-owned residential property, original documents are available, I need 40 lakhs, and prefer 10 years.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I work as a salaried executive with salary credited to bank account.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Current market value is about 95 lakhs.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Neha Kapoor! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
